run_MessageFactory_GetPrototype: run MessageFactory.GetPrototype to dynamically create a protobuf message class from a descriptor
run_GetMessages: run message_factory.GetMessages to generate all message classes from a list of FileDescriptorProtos
test_MessageFactory_extensions: test that MessageFactory correctly registers and retrieves protobuf extensions on dynamic message classes
test_duplicate_extension_number: test that MessageFactory raises an exception when two extensions target the same field number
review_MessageFactoryTest: review the MessageFactoryTest class to understand how dynamic protobuf message classes are exercised and serialized
